title: Core
description: Common Data Types, String Types, Enumerations, and Data Groups

schema_author.description: Name of the organization that published the schema
schema_author.notes: Identifies the organization that defined the schema

schema_name.notes: Identifies the schema used to define the data content

schema_version.description: The version of the schema the data complies with

schema_url.description: The Uniform Resource Locator (url) for the schema definition and/or documentation

author.description: Name of the entity creating the serialization
author.notes: Identifies the organization that created the file

id.notes: Assigned by *data publisher* to identify this data. `id` shall remain unchanged for revisions of the same data.

description.description: Description of data content (suitable for display)

time_of_creation.description: Timestamp indicating when the serialization was created
time_of_creation.notes: Updated anytime any data content is modified

version.description: Integer version identifier for the data
notes: Used by data publisher to track revisions of the data
Shall be incremented for each data revision
Used by data publisher to document methods (e.g., software and version) used to generate data
**Informative note:** `source` may be different from other data source(s) included elsewhere within the data

disclaimer.description: Characterization of accuracy, limitations, and applicability of this data

copyright.notes: **Informative note:** e.g., 'Copyright © 2024 Acme Corporation. All rights reserved.'

license.description: License governing use, reproduction, and distribution of the data
license.notes: **Informative note:** May be an SPDX identifier (e.g., 'CC-BY-4.0'), a URL to the license terms, or the full license text

expiration_date.description: Date after which the data is no longer considered valid by the data publisher
